title: DPW to Convert Two Traffic Signals at Intersections To Flashing Lights
summary: DPW will convert traffic signals at two intersections (S. Geddes & W. Onondaga Street, Grant Boulevard & Lemoyne Avenue) to flashing lights from November 1 through April 1 annually to improve winter safety. S. Geddes will have flashing yellow (proceed with caution), while W. Onondaga and Lemoyne Avenue will have flashing red (complete stop required). This semi-annual seasonal adjustment reflects a recurring public safety operational procedure.
